_about: Titan overlay, deep-merged over data/events.json. Solar flares and moonquakes stay on the Moon (null removes them). Types: rules/types.ts EventsFile, rules/titanTypes.ts RainstormSpec.

rainstorm._placeholder: Rules (T3), proposed design: one methane rainstorm per mission, forecast 60 s ahead by the lander's weather station, about 60 s long. Visibility closes in, photos do not count, the cold rises faster. Window, ramp and factors are stubs; the source is to fact-check (R).
rainstorm.source: [to fact-check] Cassini saw large equatorial storms darken the surface with rain in 2010 (Turtle et al., Science 331, 2011).
